name: encode_record / decode_record

test_list.description: A valid old envelope retains schema 1 in its storage prefix and on decode.
Refuse an envelope whose validated schema disagrees with its storage prefix.
Every sdk Event variant encodes and decodes unchanged.
Empty, 1-byte and non-JSON payloads are Codec errors.
A schema prefix above the supported version is SchemaTooNew.
proptest: arbitrary bytes decode to Ok or Err, never panic.

output_description: Self-describing encoding (postcard cannot decode the sdk's internally tagged events: VERIFIED).
